
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /ratelimit  (/rl, /limit)                  │
  │  Rate Limit Settings                        │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Set API call limit per turn to control agent throughput.

  Usage:
    /ratelimit

  Details:
    Choose how many API calls the agent can make per turn:
      Light (15)     - Conservative, good for simple tasks
      Standard (30)  - Balanced, recommended for most work
      Heavy (75)     - For complex multi-step tasks
      Intensive (100)- For large refactors and deep analysis
      Maximum (200)  - Maximum throughput, use with caution
    
    Setting is saved and persists across sessions.

  Examples:
    $ /ratelimit
    $ /rl

  Tips:
    Tip: Start with Standard and increase if you hit limits on complex tasks.

  Related: /switch  /config  /settings
